observations.notes: 9M26 NPAT AED 5.61bn (+5.5% YoY; PBT AED 6.43bn +6.3%), assets AED 317.64bn (+17.8% YoY), CET1 12.4%, NPA ratio improved sharply to 2.0% (vs 3.3% 9M25).

capital_structure_tranches.observation: Perpetual callable AT1 Sukuk; issuer rated A+ Fitch / A2 Moody's.

verdict.stance: Overweight / High-Growth Abu Dhabi Islamic Franchise (A+ / A2)
verdict.summary: ADIB expanded total assets 17.8% YoY to AED 317.6bn in 9M26 while cutting its NPA ratio to 2.0% (from 3.3%) and posting AED 5.61bn net profit (+5.5% YoY). Solid 12.4% CET1 and strong Abu Dhabi retail/sovereign deposit base underpin A+/A2 ratings.

positives: NPA ratio compressed 130bps YoY to 2.0% in 9M26 alongside 17.8% asset growth.
Strong Abu Dhabi retail/government Islamic franchise with 12.4% CET1.
Established UAE banking franchise with systemic liquidity access and regulatory oversight.
negatives: Rapid 17.8% YoY balance sheet growth requires continued capital retention.
UAE corporate tax + Pillar Two drag on net margins.
Direct linkage to UAE sovereign credit ceiling, local policy rate cycles, and FX volatility.

background.business_overview: Leading Abu Dhabi-headquartered Sharia-compliant universal bank.
background.asset_perimeter: UAE retail, wholesale, private banking, and Egypt (ADIB Egypt).
background.ownership_governance: Emirates International Investment Co. / Abu Dhabi sovereign-linked; ADX listed.

recent_drivers: 2025A: FY25 assets AED 281bn, NPAT AED 7.1bn (+16% YoY; PBT AED 8.1bn), NPA ratio 2.8%.

Provides audited FY26 figures, updated leverage/capital print, and 2027 guidance for Abu Dhabi Islamic Bank (ADIB).

management_guidance_tracker.variance_analysis: Strong recoveries & UAE growth compressed NPA 130bps.
